requirements.requirement: The system must render a confidence indicator in chat responses when a confidence score is present in the API response.
The system must display the confidence score as a percentage value (0–100%) in the message metadata area.
The system must support rendering a qualitative label (e.g., Low, Medium, High) derived from the numeric confidence score.
The system must map numeric confidence ranges to qualitative labels consistently (e.g., 0–39 Low, 40–69 Medium, 70–100 High).
The system must ensure the confidence indicator is visually distinguishable from the primary quality score in the message UI.
The system must render the confidence indicator within the existing MessageBubble component without breaking existing message layouts.
The system must not render a confidence indicator if the API response does not include a confidence object.
The system must gracefully handle malformed confidence data by omitting the indicator and logging a frontend error.
The system must ensure that rendering the confidence indicator does not increase message render time beyond acceptable UI thresholds.
The system must support confidence indicator display for both provider and clinical trial evaluation responses.
The system must ensure the confidence indicator is included in serialized chat message data passed through the rendering pipeline.
The system must maintain backward compatibility such that messages without confidence data render identically to prior versions.
The system must correctly round or format the confidence percentage to a maximum of one decimal place for display.
The system must ensure that confidence values outside the valid range (below 0 or above 100) are not displayed and are treated as invalid input.
